title: Best 10K Races in Southeast Asia
intro: The 10K almost never stands alone here — it's typically the middle option at an event built around a half marathon, with a 5K underneath it for the same crowd. Coverage skews heavily toward the Philippines, which runs a dense weekend calendar of city and provincial races nearly year-round, with Malaysia's JomRun series and scattered events across Indonesia and Thailand filling out the rest. Because so many hosts bundle the 10K in with longer distances at the same start line, picking one is less about finding a 10K specifically and more about finding a race day with the right overall lineup.
editorial_notes: Entity list resolves from the filters at build time, so it stays current without edits. Sorted soonest-first to match the rest of the site.

faqs.question: Is the 10K usually a stand-alone race in Southeast Asia?
faqs.answer: Rarely. Almost every event on this list pairs the 10K with a half marathon and a 5K at the same venue, so runners choosing the 10K are usually picking one distance out of a menu rather than entering a dedicated 10K race.

faqs.question: Which country has the most 10K options?
faqs.answer: The Philippines, by a wide margin — its weekend race calendar runs close to year-round across cities like Davao, Cagayan de Oro and Iloilo. Malaysia's JomRun series is the next most consistent source, with Indonesia and Thailand contributing individual events rather than a running series.
